integrity: Analytic proof for every integer m>=2 and all positive real parameters; exact finite rational checker independently compares selected cases, not a replacement for the proof. Independent external mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Positive alternating edge prices and a single total linear rate-cost budget; unnormalized combinatorial Laplacian and continuous-time symmetric diffusion only. Does not cover arbitrary price profiles or discrete-time SLEM. Indexed and inspected literature cannot exclude unindexed equivalents.
title: Unique optimal spectral-gap allocation on an even cycle with alternating edge prices
